name: Writesonic
tagline: Writesonic is an AI writing platform covering blog posts, marketing copy, product descriptions, and long-form articles with a suite of content-specific templates. Its Chatsonic assistant can browse the web for real-time information and generate content grounded in current events. Content teams use Writesonic as a high-volume content engine that accelerates production without requiring a larger writing staff.
